title: Answer-first marketing articles: answer before the pitch
seoTitle: Answer-First Marketing Articles: A Practical Guide | Faraz Ansari
description: A practical way to write answer-first marketing articles with clear decisions, credible evidence and no unsupported AEO or GEO ranking promises.
deck: Answer the reader's question, show the evidence and give them a useful next step — without mistaking good writing for an AI-search trick.
